subject: West Coast Partner Circuit — booth rotation, MDF split, & webinar tie-in
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@cloudwaveevents.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Torres <evan@cloudwave.com>
Date: 2025-08-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: West Coast Partner Circuit — booth rotation proposal

Hi Diego,

Hope you’re well. We’re organizing a West Coast partner roadshow this fall (3 stops: SF, LA, and Seattle). CloudWave is offering a shared booth option and a small co-hosted webinar in between stops. We think Redwood would be a great fit for a joint presence.

Key items:
- Booth rotation schedule (we’d split days across partners)
- MDF allocation: base credit + performance bonus (leads generated)
- Shared webinar slot to promote on-site sessions

I’ve attached a draft sponsor agreement and a preliminary floorplan for the SF stop. Can you confirm interest and high-level budget cadence? If yes, I’ll follow up with a proposed MDF workplan.

Best,
Alyssa
Director, Partner Events
CloudWave Events

[Attachment: sponsor_agreement.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: booth_floorplan.png (PNG)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@cloudwaveevents.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-18T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: West Coast Partner Circuit — booth rotation proposal

Thanks Alyssa — this looks promising. Redwood is interested in the SF and LA legs. High-level answers:
- Budget: we can commit $18k MDF per city as a starting point and propose a 20% bonus tied to qualified meeting conversions.
- Booth: prefer a 10x20 corner with lead capture station and a small demo staging area.
- Webinar: happy to co-host; we can provide a short product demo + customer panel.

Looping in Marissa (Field Marketing) and Hannah (Partner Ops) to confirm operational feasibility and timing. Please share the MDF workplan when ready.

Cheers,
Diego
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

On Sun, Aug 17, 2025 at 09:12 AM Alyssa Chen <alyssa@cloudwaveevents.com> wrote:
> Hi Diego,
>
> Hope you’re well...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: West Coast Partner Circuit — booth rotation proposal

Diego — I like the fit. A few operational notes:
- We need final booth floorplan by 9/8 to lock furniture/AV. Current floorplan is tight for a 10x20 demo area; ask CW for a low-resketch with electrical drops called out.
- MDF: prefer 60/40 split (CloudWave/Redwood) on base credit for each city, with lead-bonus pool handled as a pass-through: we pay bonus to CloudWave after net-qualified leads are verified.
- Creative: we’ll provide a co-branded deck and 1-pager, plus one paid social push per city.

Action: Hannah, can you own the MDF contract review and payout schedule? Marcus — can you check AV costs vs our event budget?

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-21T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: West Coast Partner Circuit — booth rotation proposal

On Thu, Aug 19, 2025 at 02:21 PM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Diego — I like the fit. A few operational notes:
> - We need final booth floorplan by 9/8 to lock furniture/AV...

Thanks — I’ll take MDF contract review. Quick notes after an initial read of the sponsor_agreement.pdf:
- Need explicit payment milestones (deposit, city-by-city drawdown, final reconciliation).
- Add SLA for lead delivery format (CSV + HubSpot IDs) and timing (within 7 business days of event).
- Request audit rights clause to validate lead quality (sample of 10% random leads).

I’ll draft redlines and circulate by Friday (8/22). Also attaching a proposed MDF workplan with payout dates and KPIs.

[Attachment: mdf_workplan.xlsx (XLSX)]

Cheers,
Hannah
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@cloudwaveevents.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-08-25T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: West Coast Partner Circuit — booth rotation proposal

Appreciate the quick feedback. Attached: updated sponsor_agreement with payment milestones and lead delivery language, plus a simplified SF floorplan (added an electrical callout).

Couple asks from our side:
- Can Redwood commit to a single case-study customer to join the SF demo slot? That will help drive registration.
- Would you be open to a 55/45 MDF split (CloudWave/Redwood) if we increase the base exposure (larger logo on stage) and commit to a dedicated email send to our database?

If you can answer by 9/1, we’ll lock booth placement.

Best,
Alyssa

[Attachment: sponsor_agreement.pdf (Updated)]
[Attachment: booth_floorplan.png (Updated)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@cloudwaveevents.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-02T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: West Coast Partner Circuit — booth rotation proposal

Thanks everyone — quick decisions and next steps:

Decisions:
- Commit to SF & LA city legs.
- MDF: agree to 55/45 (CloudWave/Redwood) conditional on dedicated email and larger stage logo.
- Case study: Marcus will confirm a customer panel (tentatively SecureBank).

Next steps / owners: 
- Hannah: finalize redlines and sign sponsor agreement by 9/10. (Attachment: final sponsor_agreement.pdf will be routed via DocuSign)
- Marissa: finalize creative assets and paid social calendar by 9/12.
- Marcus: confirm SecureBank availability + produce short speaker brief by 9/8.
- Diego: coordinate webinar date and secure promo copy with CloudWave.

Alyssa — please send DocuSign link once redlines are accepted. We’ll route internally for approval and commit to the MDF funding schedule after signature.

Thanks,
Diego
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
